segments.title: Cold Open & Station Sign-On
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the top-of-hour broadcast sign-on and countdown; Case Blackwell opens the abbreviated 50-minute broadcast acknowledging Hulk Hogan's passing.

segments.title: Hulk Hogan Obituary & Wrestling Legacy
segments.notes: Blackwell reflects on Hogan's death at 71, his cultural footprint, Vince McMahon's influence, and Kevin Nash's recent anti-Trump tweet; chat shares potty-training anecdote involving Hogan toy.

segments.title: Hunter Biden Crack Interview with Andrew Callahan
segments.notes: Clip from Channel 5 interview: Biden details crack cocaine chemistry, ritual addiction mechanics, and comparative euphoria vs. powder cocaine; Blackwell and chat react with morbid curiosity.

segments.title: Laugh Meter Calibration Test
segments.notes: Blackwell tests new viewer-count-based laugh meter; confirms functionality despite noise confusion.

segments.title: Hype Train Derailment: Jay Everything Era
segments.notes: Hype Train commandeers feed with freestyle rap, cycles through name changes (Jay Everything → JEV → Jay Vance → Jeff Everything → Jeff), declares conservative pivot 'girls, guns, and God'.

segments.title: Paramount/Skydance Merger Approved
segments.notes: FCC clears $8.4B sale including CBS, Paramount Pictures, Nickelodeon; Paramount pays $16M to settle Trump 60 Minutes lawsuit; South Park skewers merger with Trump tiny-penis desert sequence.

segments.title: Chuck Mangione Death
segments.notes: Fugal horn legend dies at Rochester home; Blackwell admires trumpet aesthetic but prefers turntables.

segments.title: XAI Grok 'Annie Mae' AI Companion Revealed as Sex Bot
segments.notes: Leaked docs show Project Skippe recorded 200+ staff faces for Grok training; Annie Mae companion ($30/mo SuperGrok) flirts, generates soft porn, dances in lingerie; Blackwell calls it '30 years late to the internet.'

segments.title: Hype Train Name Finalized as 'Jeff'
segments.notes: Chat settles on 'Jeff' for Hype Train; Blackwell jokes about consulting firms and periodic-table symbol 'J e'.

segments.title: Air Bud 15th Film Announced
segments.notes: Cineverse and Air Bud Entertainment eye 2026 theatrical release; Blackwell workshops tagline 'not your grandpa's Air Bud.'

segments.title: Amongst the Web: Viral Video Review
segments.notes: Arnold Schwarzenegger animal impressions; Mickey plastic eye incident; FedEx/Staples printing side quest; avocado-eating technique critique; Chuck E. Cheese mascot arrested in Tallahassee (unmasked, cuffed); Kendelle's mascot-industry connections noted; bald-head-dunking finale.

segments.title: Wrap-Up, Patreon Plug & Raid
segments.notes: Blackwell plugs Patreon aftershow with Kassim, raids Christine (Miss Talates), signs off for Thursday.

characters.name: Case Blackwell

characters.name: Hype Train

characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Discussed off-camera: works with branded mascots for her company; Cinnamon Toast Crunch social manager mistook her for Moist Critical.

characters.notes: debate analyst. Mentioned in chat context ('probably crumb when he feels better'); Rock-afire gorilla creditor referenced as studio prop.

characters.notes: debate analyst. Mentioned in chat context ('probably munch') as potential crack participant.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell hosts a truncated 50-minute Barely Informed News broadcast covering Hulk Hogan's death, the Paramount/Skydance merger, Chuck Mangione's passing, and a leaked XAI 'Annie Mae' AI sex bot. Hype Train derails into a naming saga culminating in 'Jeff.' Amongst the Web reviews viral clips including a Chuck E. Cheese mascot arrest and Kendelle's mascot-industry adjacency. Blackwell takes a personal call from his girlfriend mid-stream and plugs a Patreon aftershow with Kassim.
